_help.what_this_is: The ONE place every not-yet-decided Wharton fact lives. Fill these in, set "live" to true, run `python3 scripts/build_wharton.py`, and every page (hero, schedule, pricing, location cards, footer, JSON-LD, robots, sitemap, llms.txt) updates together. See wharton-site/README.md.
_help.live: false = coming-soon mode: every page is noindex, robots.txt disallows everything, there is no sitemap, and NOTHING below is rendered even if it is filled in. true = public mode: noindex is removed and whatever is filled in below appears; anything still empty keeps its 'coming soon' message.
_help.address: street (and optional suite) and zip are the TBD parts. city and state are already known.
_help.opening_date: ISO date, for example 2026-12-01. Shown as 'Classes start December 1, 2026' (or 'Now open' once the build date has passed).
_help.schedule: List of {"day": "Monday", "start": "18:00", "end": "19:00", "class": "Women's Self Defense Jiu-Jitsu", "type": "Gi" or "No-Gi" or "", "audience": "adult" or "kids" or "women" or "all", "note": ""}. 'start' may be empty or left out when the time has not been announced: the row then shows 'Time to be announced' after the timed rows of its day. 'end' needs a 'start'. 'note' is optional.
_help.pricing: List of {"name": "Adult Unlimited", "audience": "adult" or "kids" or "family" or "other", "price": "149", "period": "month" or "class" or "hour" or "", "note": "", "features": ["..."], "featured": false}. 'other' items render as small add-on rows.
_help.kids_ages: Free text, for example 'ages 5 to 15'. Empty means 'age groups will be confirmed with the schedule'.
_help.joe_photo: Path inside wharton-site/, for example assets/joe-herrera.jpg (put a .webp with the same name beside it if you can). Empty means the monogram portrait card is shown.
_help.map_url: A Google Maps (or other) link to the gym. Shown as a Get directions button.
_help.social: Wharton-specific profile URLs. Empty ones are not shown.
_help.lastmod: Date written into sitemap.xml. Update it when you change content.
